name: io.github.heartleo/zlib
title: Z-Library
description: Search and download Z-Library books, fix e-book metadata, and send books to Kindle or WeRead.

environmentVariables.name: ZLIB_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose only read tools: no download, history deletion, Kindle or WeRead delivery, or metadata editing.

environmentVariables.name: ZLIB_MCP_ALLOWED_DIR
environmentVariables.description: A folder to keep downloads, Kindle attachments, WeRead imports and the metadata tools inside. Leave empty for no limit.
